root-new-programme-repair-preflight-2026.actual_root_read: Root read the complete two-page AN-K-053; monograph7.1–7.8, representative sampling and dilution/extraction/homogenization branches,10.1.1 and10.1.5 with adjacent alternatives. root-new-programme-repair-preflight-2026.positive: A practical whole toothpaste direct-beaker water programme exists, with sealed weighed sampling, specified solvent and apparatus, real blanks for titer and sample and a reference-standard titer. The complete monograph supplies representative preserved sampling and explicit interference/alternate preparation branches. Actual field recovery has not been performed; the six-run note is precision only. This evidence is materially different from a generic KF title or loss-on-drying assumption.
root-new-programme-repair-preflight-2026.source_limits: Do not copy the book endpoint-mL versus blank-mg subtraction, mg/g percent scaling, or approximate dilution25 for a two-gram sample plus50grams solvent. A homogeneous whole dilution and a settled supernatant have different represented-sample fractions; no universal complete extraction is inferred. Preserve aldehyde/ketone, carbonate/oxide and terminal-silanol limits without declaring every hydrated silica automatically invalid.
root-new-programme-repair-preflight-2026.boundary_review: The original water_vapour row says only actual separately established environmental vapor; the gel_aerosol row refers to actual wet droplets at a real air outlet. Primary mixing guides do not establish that the vessel vacuum port is an environmental outlet or that wet-gel aerosol is universal. Keep real internal vacuum/receiver/pump interfaces and final external outlets distinct. Patent cold traps are qualified technical precedents for different abrasive products, not proof of a trap in the selected gel plant. No operation, outlet or burden may be removed or paper-outsourced.
root-new-programme-repair-preflight-2026.remaining_affected_claim: If an actual final environmental outlet contains wet droplets and separate original phase exports are required, the phase-preserving collection and full recovery programme remains a concrete affected-study hold. Heating into FTIR does not recover original phase. Do not use a conditional row to invent a universal release or declare it absent. Actual complete producer topology and matrix qualification remain explicit.
